intent: Prefer local LLM execution for most delegatable preprocessing and low-risk reasoning while reserving Antigravity and Codex for high-value judgment, implementation, and verification.

localFirst.allowCodingWhen: read-only review, patch planning, test idea generation, or small low-risk draft work
avoidWhen: direct edits have high correctness risk
GPU/VRAM pressure would disrupt the user's machine

cloudEscalation.codexUse: bounded implementation, difficult debugging, tests, refactors, and code review requiring strong coding judgment
cloudEscalation.antigravityUse: interactive IDE judgment, user-visible diff review, final acceptance, and cross-agent routing decisions

weeklyResetBoost.effect: Lower the threshold for Codex/Antigravity on useful high-quality work when weekly quota would otherwise expire unused.

decisionLayers: Can local LLM do this reliably enough?
If not, is cloud quota worth spending now given reset timing and task risk?
